title: OpenQEvo LLM Recommendation
description: Schema for an LLM-generated quantum evolution method recommendation backed by OpenQEvo context and optionally executable through openqevo.execute_recommendation(...).

recommendation_id.description: Stable identifier for this recommendation response.

method_name.description: Recommended OpenQEvo method or planned method name.

method_family.description: Context family or method grouping, such as trotterization, randomized_methods, interaction_picture, annealing, or exact.

executable.description: Whether the recommendation can be passed to openqevo.execute_recommendation(...) with the supplied inputs.

confidence.description: Confidence in the recommendation given available context and user inputs.

parameters.description: Method parameters to pass to execution or to request from the user.

required_inputs.description: Inputs still required before execution is possible.

execution.description: Execution payload compatible with openqevo.execute_recommendation(...) when executable is true.

implemented.description: Whether the selected method is implemented and registered.

non_executable_reason.description: Required in practice when executable is false; explains the missing method, contract, backend, or inputs.

rationale.description: Concise reasoning steps for the recommendation.

warnings.description: Limitations, validation requirements, or caveats the user should see.

evidence.description: Evidence links into the context stack.

key_point_id.description: Stable key-point ID supporting the recommendation.

alternatives.description: Other methods considered but not selected.
